26.name: Fumbling in the dark
26.overview: Bram Krikke, Daan Boom, Delilah Warcup-van Eyck, Eveline Stallaart, Geraldine Kemper, Matteo van der Grijn, Milan van Dongen, Nasrdin Dchar, Nienke van Dijk, and Quinty Misiedjan attempt to earn as much money as possible by completing challenges. The search begins in Manyara, where the candidates trek through pristine nature in jeeps. In the wilderness, among elephants, zebras, and giraffes, they must keep a cool head. Here too, a good start is half the battle. For on this safari, nothing is what it seems: who dares to trust their own intuition? And who makes the right decision? In this opening phase, the candidates know one thing for sure: every choice can be directly decisive for the continuation of their search.

26.name: Through the eye of the needle
26.overview: A player who has been eliminated is given the opportunity to return to the game. Mole tricks took place at the market and in the parking lot where the jeeps were parked.

26.name: Looking through different eyes
26.overview: The candidates put on their sportswear to take on the Tanzanian team in an exciting football match. While the majority get ready for the kick-off, there are also two substitutes who head straight to a festively decorated living room filled with flags and festive decorations. A surprising role awaits them here: by playing a challenging bar game, they can hinder the opponents on the field by earning a ‘freeze’. This strategic move could completely turn the game around. Moreover, every goal scored earns the team a handsome reward of no less than €100.00. A combination of sporting competition, clever tactics, and a festive atmosphere makes this an unforgettable adventure.

26.name: Follow blindly
26.overview: With him in our alliance, we have a strong team. Being aware of your surroundings and paying attention to details are the key to this assignment. The Mole has distributed the maximum amount of €2,000.00 among the safes. Note the word ‘gas station’ – easier said than done. Using photos and a cryptic description, they must decipher the password. A maximum of two people are allowed on the field. Which safes are they going to open? Watch out for guards who can shoot you; you’ll lose your money immediately, and not everyone plays fair. There is also a telephone attached to a high silo, accessible via abseiling. At the lifelines, you can earn money and an advantage for the quiz, up to €4,000.00. And then comes the quiz: whoever scores the worst or spreads out their answers must leave the game.

26.name: To look out of the corner of one eye
26.overview:
Every cup of coffee costs a lot here; there is a name in Shawhill in the factory, and if you pick the right one, you earn 50 euros and must weigh exactly 20 kg. But sometimes the text makes absolutely no sense. The mole here is so naive as to make a perfect mistake at the coffee bean slide. Will that be noticed? And who will find the jokers? The search for jokers has taken a lot of time; it is not always Joker Day.

Welcome to this coffee plantation! Soon it will rain money, and you must try to grab it. Watch out for the guards, and a maximum of two people are allowed to enter the field. Make sure you are on time for the drone; there is a nice sum to be earned.

26.name: To see through someone else's eyes
26.overview: Yesterday, one of the participants received a secret assignment from the Mole. If successfully completed, this assignment yields €1,000.00, while the Mole will actively try to prevent money from entering the pot. The specific task involves a participant formulating four sentences containing the word “eye.” If this assignment is completed, the participant in question will receive two jokers, and the group will go home with zero euros. During the day, a walk is on the program, followed by participation in a traditional Maasai activity: carrying water. This challenge can yield €400.00. Next, there is a javelin throwing segment, where hitting the target is worth €150.00 per spear. Finally, the first two candidates to take a seat in the jeep will take the leap, bringing the tension of the day to a climax.

26.name: Every pair of eyes counts
26.overview: Welcome to Zanzibar. This is your bar, which must match the six photos provided exactly. You will receive €100.00 for every correct detail, but the Mole will naturally try to conceal these details. Everything is being removed and the details will be added later, although one ball is currently missing. Meanwhile, two others are performing an impressive high-altitude tandem jump while simultaneously having to memorize cocktails. Soon, you will be divided into three duos: in the first, one person must act out and the other guess; in the second, a duo chooses the music, though the songs are played backwards. Finally, Rik asks exam questions; answer these correctly and you will come face to face with the Mole. If all three questions are answered correctly, you will earn €200.00.

26.name: See through
26.overview: With Robbie Williams' 'Let Me Entertain You' playing in the background, the mole was given the perfect opportunity to fulfill their role. The energetic dance later transformed into an exhilarating African choreography, completely shifting the atmosphere. Next, the group moves to a theater filled with ordinary families to perform their show. The question remains: will the mole be able to subtly sabotage here, or will they allow money to be earned? The more enthusiastic the applause, the more money in the pot, but how will the audience react? Will it be exuberant, or will it remain very quiet? And then comes the dreaded test, the moment of truth. Who has to pack their bags and leave the game? The tension rises to unprecedented heights as everyone wonders who gets to play for one more round.

26.name: Couldn't believe my eyes
26.overview: Is the mole the treasurer? And then, what everyone had been hoping for: the shooting challenge. You can earn more than just money, because you get to view some mole diaries. To do so, however, you have to do something: stop the intruders. Then, the eliminated contestants appear incognito, dressed in animal costumes. Are you ready for the final safari? This is the very last chance to earn money and come face-to-face with the mole. And then there is that annoying test again. Who will be eliminated, just before the finale?

26.name: Final
26.overview: Back in the Netherlands, we have only one goal: to find out who screwed us over the most and who is walking away with the pot? And we are doing just that, old-fashioned, at this reunion.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Final
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Back in the Netherlands, we have only one goal: to find out who screwed us over the most and who is walking away with the pot? And we are doing just that, old-fashioned, at this reunion.

overview: Ten candidates have to complete assignments to earn money. However, one of the group members is the Mole. The Mole's goal is to make the assignments fail and keep the amount of money earned as low as possible. The other candidates do not know who the Mole is and need to unmask them. At the end of every episode, the candidates take a multiple-choice test about the mole's identity. The person who gives the least amount of correct answers is "executed" and must leave. This process continues until only two contestants and the Mole remain. The winner is the person with the most correct answers in the final test and they get all of the money earned in previous stages of the game.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: 9 contestants and 1 mole (mol). The nine contestants have to complete a series of challenges. When challenges are successfully completed, a certain amount of money is earned. When a challenge is lost, money can be lost, depending on the challenge. The tenth contestant is the mole: a saboteur. He should deliberately sabotage as many of the challenges as possible. The mole has to stay undercover as the contestants are trying to find the mole. At the end of every 2 days the contestants get 20 questions about the mole. Who ever knows least about the mole gets eliminated and goes home. At the end of the series 3 candidates are left: the loser, the winner and the mole. The winner gets all the money gathered by the contestants. The mole cannot win any money.

title: Wie is de Mol?
